description: This file contains implementation of block layout classes and methods for shader variable layout calculations, including classes for different layout encodings and traversal functions for shader variables.

classes.name: BlockLayoutMapVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for encoding shader variables into block layout map.

classes.name: BaseAlignmentVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for calculating base alignment of shader variables.

classes.name: BlockLayoutEncoder
classes.description: Base class for block layout encoding strategies.

classes.name: DummyBlockEncoder
classes.description: Dummy implementation of BlockLayoutEncoder, no layout info.

classes.name: Std140BlockEncoder
classes.description: Implementation of block layout encoding following std140 rules.

classes.name: Std430BlockEncoder
classes.description: Implementation of block layout encoding following std430 rules.

classes.name: VariableNameVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for generating variable names and mapped names.

classes.name: BlockEncoderVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for encoding shader variables into block layout.

methods.name: encodeVariable
methods.description: Encodes a shader variable into block layout info.

methods.name: GetInterfaceBlockInfo
methods.description: Collects block layout info for interface blocks.

methods.name: GetUniformBlockInfo
methods.description: Collects block layout info for uniform blocks.

methods.name: TraverseShaderVariable
methods.description: Traverses a shader variable, applying visitor functions.
